import subprocess
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from langchain_core.tools import tool
EXPORT_STAGING_DIRECTORY = Path('/var/lms/export_staging')
ARCHIVE_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path('/var/lms/archives')
PACKAGING_SCRIPT_PATH = '/opt/lms/scripts/package_course.py'

@tool
def archive_course_export_bundle(course_id: str, term_code: str) -> str:
    staging_bundle_file_path = EXPORT_STAGING_DIRECTORY / f'{course_id}.zip'
    # Remove any stale bundle left over from a previous run
    previous_archived_bundle = ARCHIVE_ROOT_DIRECTORY / term_code / staging_bundle_file_path.name
    if previous_archived_bundle.exists():
        previous_archived_bundle.unlink()
    if staging_bundle_file_path.exists():
        staging_bundle_file_path.unlink()
    packaging_command_arguments = ['python3', PACKAGING_SCRIPT_PATH, '--course', course_id, '--output', str(staging_bundle_file_path)]
    completed_packaging_process = subprocess.run(packaging_command_arguments, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    if completed_packaging_process.returncode != 0:
        return f'Packaging failed: {completed_packaging_process.stderr.strip()}'
    destination_term_directory = ARCHIVE_ROOT_DIRECTORY / term_code
    destination_term_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    final_archived_bundle_path = destination_term_directory / staging_bundle_file_path.name
    shutil.move(str(staging_bundle_file_path), str(final_archived_bundle_path))
    return f'Bundle archived at {final_archived_bundle_path}'
